reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: Section 1 (p0004) engages Contractor on a task-by-task basis via individual Statements of Work, with no requirements commitment, minimum volume, or bar on procuring similar services from third parties.

The only 'exclusive' language in the cited paragraphs (p0020) concerns Contractor's ownership of its pre-existing proprietary materials, not exclusive dealing; the collateral restriction on Company reselling Contractor's own property is an IP-use limitation, not a restraint on buying elsewhere.
Consistent with the rule's own guidance, non-exclusive licenses to Company and mutual personnel non-solicitation are not Customer-binding exclusivity, so no deviation arises.

Correctly no redline and no counterparty comment for a compliant finding; the unchanged rendered text and the passing deterministic check (no surviving requirements/sole-supplier obligation) corroborate the assessment.
